LAREDO — Here is your Webb County week ahead: warm most days, a midweek rain chance, and a hot Halloween weekend finish.

Monday is partly cloudy, high near 88, low near 69. Tuesday turns cloudier, high near 86, low near 70. Wednesday is mostly cloudy and warmer at 89, with showers late and a 50 percent rain chance overnight, low 72.

Thursday is the wettest and coolest day, with showers, high near 82, low near 72. Friday dries out, partly cloudy, high near 88, low near 72. Saturday, Halloween, is partly cloudy and warm at 90, low near 73. Sunday is the hottest day, partly cloudy, high near 92, low near 74.

Rain chances are 20 percent or less except Wednesday night and Thursday, at 50 percent. Winds stay light to moderate from the east and southeast, 7 to 13 mph. No weather alerts are in effect for Webb County.

Bottom line: keep an umbrella handy Thursday; the rest of the week, including Halloween, looks warm, mostly dry, and good for getting out. Stay cool out there, Webb County.

Sources:

  • Weather.com — Laredo, TX 10-day forecast
